main_topics.reason: The user asked whether psoriasis patches itch more at night and why, then sought ways to reduce the itching.
The user said they wake up with skin raw from scratching and discussed ways to limit damage overnight.
The user asked what helps and followed up on whether greasy ointment works better than regular cream.

output.summary: The user asked why their psoriasis patches itch more at night and what might help; they said the patches are mostly on their elbows and one knee and that scratching in their sleep sometimes leaves the skin raw. They accepted suggestions including a cooler room, ointment before bed, and a loose cotton layer over the knee, and said the answer was what they needed.
